name: dispersion_curve
caption: Phase and group speed vs wavenumber for h=6mm ice. Minimum phase speed c_min marks the critical speed below which no steady waves exist.

name: rw_curve
caption: C_W(Fn) for ice-covered (h=6mm) vs open water. The ice-covered curve shows a sharp peak near the critical speed Fn* ≈ c_min/√(gL).

name: fn_star_migration
caption: Fn* increases monotonically with ice thickness, following the c_min/√(gL) scaling. This confirms the physical mechanism: thicker ice → higher flexural rigidity → higher critical speed.

name: energy_balance
caption: Far-field flexural wave energy flux vs R_flex·U. The ~5-12% discrepancy is attributed to numerical integration and the approximate nature of the energy flux formula for ice-covered waves.
